gaps.sentence: The ___ majority voted against the proposal.
gaps.explanation: 'An overwhelming majority' = far more than half.

gaps.sentence: Be careful not to ___ your passport at the check-in desk.
gaps.explanation: 'Lose' is the verb; 'loose' means not tight.

gaps.sentence: Do you know ___ bag this is?
Take my ___ and sell the car before the prices fall.
gaps.explanation: 'Take my advice' — the noun form follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The new timetable has ___ every commuter in the county.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' = influence; 'effect' as a verb means bring about.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ what he was saying because of the noise.
gaps.explanation: 'Hear' means to receive sound; 'listen' means to pay attention deliberately and needs 'to'.

gaps.sentence: Pens, envelopes and paper are sold in the ___ department.
gaps.explanation: 'Stationery' means writing materials; 'stationary' is an adjective meaning not moving.

gaps.sentence: He ___ all knowledge of the missing file.
gaps.explanation: 'Deny all knowledge of something' is the fixed phrase.
